entries.headline: C-32A VENUS62 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing C-32A using callsign VENUS62, hex ADFEB7 and registration 98-0001, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Donald e Moore via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Putin border security-zone statement reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported that Vladimir Putin said Russia is establishing a “security zone” inside Ukraine along the border and that it would not be negotiable in future peace talks.

entries.headline: Gerasimov statement on strikes relayed
entries.summary: War Watch cited Gerasimov in reporting that Russian Armed Forces had begun large-scale strikes on Ukraine’s energy facilities.

entries.headline: Six high-priority US military aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported six high-priority US military aircraft airborne over the continental United States, including a nuclear command aircraft and a reconnaissance jet designed to track missile launches.

entries.headline: First Navy C-130J-30 for TACAMO program reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported that the U.S. Navy received its first C-130J-30 Super Hercules for the TACAMO program and said the aircraft would be converted.

entries.headline: Boeing E-6B with hex AFF778 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing E-6B with hex AFF778, citing a sighting by TruthSeekr60.

entries.headline: Patriot interceptor stock for Ukraine winter relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said enough PAC-2 and PAC-3 Patriot interceptors are in Europe to carry Ukraine through the winter, citing reagan0965.

entries.headline: EAM header QHZJKP reported
entries.summary: War Watch posted an EAM header and preamble report with header code QHZJKP and a displayed time of 7:35 AM.

entries.headline: US sanctions on Cuban bank relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an Insider Paper report that the United States sanctioned a Cuban bank accused of ties to an Iranian bank, citing reagan0965.

entries.headline: US, NATO and British aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the North Sea and the United States, along with a NATO surveillance aircraft and a British surveillance drone operating in the region.

entries.headline: US, NATO and British surveillance aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force transport and surveillance aircraft airborne, along with NATO surveillance jets and a British surveillance drone over the North Sea.

entries.headline: Sumy shopping-centre strike report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch said Ukrainska Pravda reported seven minutes before the wire that an enemy UAV struck a shopping centre in Sumy and injured three civilians, adding that two outlets had since confirmed the report.
